title: Duplexer Module - GPS L5 (1176 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Jennifer Kim

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Duplexer Module filter targeting GPS L5 (1176 MHz) for Millimeter-Wave Beamforming. The filter is designed on AlN on Si substrate with a target center frequency of 5038.7 MHz and bandwidth of 344.1 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Millimeter-Wave Beamforming module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Duplexer Module
- Frequency Band: GPS L5 (1176 MHz)
- Application: Millimeter-Wave Beamforming
- Substrate: AlN on Si
- Package: LGA (Land Grid Array)
- Design Tool: Keysight ADS 2024
- Design Center: Cedar Rapids Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the Duplexer Module design targeting GPS L5 (1176 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       5038.7 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       344.1 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.2 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 16.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 45.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 21.0 dB
Q Factor:               8644
Temperature Coefficient:-20.1 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.0 x 0.6 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   12
Electrode Material:     Mo/Al
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Keysight ADS 2024 and load the Duplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: AlN on Si with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 5038.7 MHz, BW 344.1 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.2 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (LGA (Land Grid Array)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, AlN on Si).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight E5080B ENA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 15116 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.2 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 16.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 516 MHz offset >= 45.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 9 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 12.7 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +27 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 86%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-05-01
Devices Tested:         82
Insertion Loss (meas):  0.87 dB
Return Loss (meas):     17.9 dB
Rejection (meas):       47.6 dB
Isolation (meas):       26.1 dB
Q Factor (meas):        8644
Group Delay Variation:  2.4 ns
Power Handling:         +32 dBm
Die Yield:              86.9%

Result Classification:  FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Duplexer Module design demonstrated below-target performance for GPS L5 (1176 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Simulation-to-measurement correlation was within 3% for all key parameters.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Optimize resonator geometry to reduce insertion loss by ~0.3 dB.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Escalate to advanced materials team for alternative piezoelectric stack.
